goals.notes: I believe in the AI revolution. I am a novice trader with not much history of success. I’d rather trade on high conviction stocks with strong growth outlooks, with some calibrated risks on stocks that could balloon, that tie into my belief in AI. I would rather not sink additional capital in if I don’t have to. I am okay to rebalance my portfolio to align with my goals. I can add capital if needed, but am already down 2 grand in loses this year. Don’t be afraid to make bold calls based on research and technicals that could find us a diamond in the rough type stock that explodes.

thesis: Own the AI buildout where the money actually lands — networks, power, data and security — plus a small explosive sleeve aimed at turning $9,469 into $25,000.

allocation.why: The software layer that gets paid every time a company puts AI to work.
Chips and networking are the toll booth on every AI data center built.
Data centers, cooling and power gear are sold out years ahead of demand.
AI cannot run without electricity, and clean baseload power is the tightest bottleneck.
One large steady anchor so the book is not all high-volatility names.
A big grower that keeps paying even if AI spending pauses for a quarter.
One cheap, fast-growing overseas name adds upside the US market does not offer.

avoided: Broad Market index funds: they would dilute your best AI ideas and cannot get $9,469 to $25,000.
Consumer staples and dividend defensives: safe and slow, wrong tool for an aggressive two-year goal.
